description.en: A cement-based preparation for a specific stage of a residential build. The application label separates tile setting, leveling and wall preparation for more accurate material lists. This listing is for type iii white thinset mortar for porcelain tile, for standard residential tile.

Este anúncio apresenta argamassa colante branca ac-iii para porcelanato, para revestimento residencial padrão.
